qingkuai.description: Configuration options used by prettier-plugin-qingkuai when formatting `.qk` files.
qingkuai.markdownDescription: Configuration options used by **prettier-plugin-qingkuai** when formatting `.qk` files.

spaceAroundInterpolation.description: Controls whether spaces are inserted inside interpolation blocks.
spaceAroundInterpolation.markdownDescription:
Controls whether spaces are inserted **inside interpolation blocks** in qingkuai component(.qk) files.

Interpolation blocks use **single curly braces**.

Example:

Without spaces:

```qingkuai
{count}
```

With spaces:

```qingkuai
{ count }
```

selfCloseEmptySlotTags.description: Convert empty slot tags to self-closing format.
selfCloseEmptySlotTags.markdownDescription:
Controls whether **empty slot tags** are converted to **self-closing** format.

Example:

Before:

```qingkuai
<slot></slot>
```

After:

```qingkuai
<slot />
```

componentTagFormatPreference.description: Controls the preferred naming style for component tags in qingkuai component(.qk) files.

componentAttributeFormatPreference.description: Controls the preferred naming style for component attributes in qingkuai component(.qk) files.

oneOf.markdownDescription:
Prefer **camel case** component attributes.

Example:

```qingkuai
<MyComponent myCustomAttribute />
```

Prefer **kebab case** component attributes.

Example:

```qingkuai
<MyComponent my-custom-attribute />
```
